scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.db:push: cd reader-backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:reset: cd reader-backend && npx prisma db push --force-reset --accept-data-loss
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run build
scripts.prod: npm run setup && cd reader-backend && node dist/index.js
